item.title: A Digital Backup Plan: Why veteran Keepers should look at Chaosium’s new Humble bundle
item.description: Chaosium’s latest Humble Bundle isn't just for beginners. Grab digital copies of Nameless Horrors, Dead Light, and the Investigator Handbook to round out your 7th Edition library.

item.title: The Death of the Safe Bet: How community toppled the IP giants
item.description: Discover how independent creators dismantled the corporate monopoly on hype. Our 14-year data analysis reveals why community intimacy now outvalues global IP.

item.title: Audio EXP Podcast: #317 – Demon Ponies vs Computers
item.description: Explore why Games Workshop is banning AI and how Gwar conquered the Pink Pony Club in this episode of Audio EXP. We also look at the rise of indie roleplaying games.

item.title: Sticki Rolls targets broader audience with major Minecraft partnership
item.description: Over 600 Minecraft stickers are coming to your wrist. Sky Castle announces a new Sticki Rolls collection featuring iconic game elements for late 2026.

item.title: Miss Hawkins? This Demogorgon mood light brings the horror home
item.description: Stranger Things may have ended last year, but the merchandise continues. We look at a new posable Demogorgon lamp featuring articulated petals.

item.title: Mercy review: Chris Pratt faces the AI Judge
item.description: Chris Pratt stars in Mercy, a near-future thriller about an AI judge. Is this dystopian courtroom drama worth your time? Read the Geek Native review.

item.title: Pinnacle Announces Standalone Deadlands Core Book for 30th Anniversary
item.description: Pinnacle Entertainment Group reveals a standalone Deadlands core book and a 30th-anniversary commemorative volume launching on BackerKit this February.

item.title: The Binding of Isaac and Smurfs board games target better localisation with new deal
item.description: Maestro Media, the studio behind The Binding of Isaac board game, partners with PTS to improve global localisation and distribution for its tabletop titles.

item.title: From travel writer to DM: How real-world wanderlust shapes extraordinary RPG locations
item.description: We interview Duncan Rhodes about his new book, The Creative Game Master's Guide to Extraordinary Locations. Learn how his background as a travel writer helps him turn generic fantasy maps into versatile, session-sustaining set pieces.

item.title: Roll with the King of Dinosaurs: Real T-Rex bone dice hit Kickstarter
item.description: Own your very own 65 million year old dinosaur bones crafted into beautiful dice and works of art.
